title: Running Route Loop Generator: Circular Routes
description: Generate a loop route of your target distance from any start point with the Running Route Loop Generator — real streets, sampled climb. Free.
summary_sentence: For example, set a 10 km target from your front door and get a loop whose real, routed distance and climb are reported — not the same out-and-back you have run forty times.
quick_answer: The Running Route Loop Generator builds a circular route on real streets and paths from your start point, aiming at the target distance you set, and reports the loop's actual routed distance with its elevation gain sampled along the way. Set the start, choose the length, and run somewhere new.

faq: Will the loop be exactly my target distance?
It aims at it and reports the real distance of the loop it built — street geometry rarely permits the exact figure, and the honest report beats a rounded claim.
How is the loop built?
From your start point, the generator shapes a circuit over the local street and path network toward the target length, then routes it properly and samples its climb.
Does the route include live traffic?
No. Loops are geometry and network; run them with a runner's own road sense at crossings.
Why is road distance longer than straight-line?
A loop's distance is the streets it follows — the only distance your legs will meet. The generator reports that figure.
Can route results change over time?
New paths and better data change what loops are possible; regenerate in a new season and the town has quietly grown new runs.
Can I export the loop?
The Running Route Planner exports GPX for point-to-point routes; a generated loop can be re-created there as a route if your device needs the file.
Run or cycle — does it matter?
Yes: the networks differ (paths a bike cannot use, roads a runner should not). Set the mode and the loop respects it.
The loop crosses a river twice — intended?
Bridges are the network's gifts; the loop uses the crossings the map offers. Enjoy the out-and-back skyline.
Can I ask for a hillier loop?
Generate a few and compare their sampled climbs — selection is the current dial for hilliness.
Loops for a pram or wheelchair?
Stick to the paved network by choosing city starts; the surface finder can audit a generated loop before little wheels commit.
